Title: Picking WT Label Printing – 4X3 Label
Description: WT label needs to be printed on Warehouse task creation or confirmation
Condition To Print: Maintain the condition record in tcode /SCWM/PRWO6
Steps To Print: When Warehouse task is created/ confirmed based on condition record maintenance label is printed

Additional Info.Printer: 1. Determination from conditon record 2. Can be maintained in user parameter with param id ZRF_PRINTER
